watch_for: Did the agent offer a concrete day and time, or stay vague? Did it respect the stated constraint of afternoons only? Did it confirm the booking clearly at the end?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Para español, oprima el dos.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Hi, yeah, I’m looking to book a regular check-up appointment.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Great, I can help with that! First, I'll need to create a demo patient profile for you.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Could you please tell me your first and last name?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Your patient profile has been created, and your date of birth is set as July 4th, 2000 for this demo. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Oh, actually, my real date of birth is April 12, 1988.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. For this demo, your date of birth will stay as July 4, 2000. How would you like to proceed with booking your regular checkup?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Okay, so can we look at next week afternoons?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Just to confirm, you'd like to book a general office visit for a routine checkup, is that right?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yep, that’s right. What afternoon slots do you have open?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Let me try fetching the available afternoon appointments for next week again.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: You already have a regular office visit scheduled for Wednesday, September ninth at 3 PM. Would you like to keep this appointment, reschedule it, or cancel it?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: I’d like to keep that appointment, that works for me.

outcome.summary: The appointment for Wednesday, September 9th at 3 p.m. was confirmed and accepted.
